skills.desc:
When in Sacred Water Stance: Restore all party members 15% \ 30% \ 45% \ 60% of Max HP
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Water type moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
